reason: The structure is better than what burned me last time, and I would take the free 15-company sample because it costs me nothing. But I am not signing EUR 1,500 this month on a promise; I have paid agencies for activity before and got nothing that turned into orders.
objection: A meeting is not a buyer. Five calls with people who were polite but never order still costs me EUR 3,000 plus my sales team's time. And 'a logistics company got 45 meetings' is a logistics company, not a manufacturer selling to foreign distributors; I want to know how many of those meetings became deals.
would_change_my_mind: The sample shows companies I have not already found myself and could actually sell to, and a 15-minute call with a past manufacturing or export client who tells me the meetings turned into real quotes or orders.
